english.notes:
(i) Section 14(3) of the Child Support Act 1991 provides that such a person is guilty of an offence if, following such a request, he fails to comply with it.
(ii) Section 14(4) of the Child Support Act 1991 provides that it is a defence for a person charged with an offence under section 14(3) to prove that he had a reasonable excuse for failing to comply.
